name: 30024 · Suwanee, GA
findings: ZIP 30024 (Suwanee) has 341 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 100 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30024 (Suwanee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 42 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
